weather_line: Fog persistent in the hollow · three words in the margin, still undisclosed

stories.headline: Steve's Three-Word Margin Note Identified as a Trail Name; the Hollow Has Been Named; Preparations Begin in an Orderly Fashion
body: The margin of the ordnance chart, which has been the subject of household speculation since Sunday afternoon, was read in full at seven-oh-four this morning when Steve set down his coffee and unrolled the map without preamble. The three words are a trail name. Sources who were present confirm it is a real trail. Sources who were also present confirm that Christine had already looked it up.

The hollow itself — four miles north-northeast of the first waymarker, accessible by a road Christine had researched by Sunday evening — is named on older charts as Harlan's Hollow, and on newer charts not at all. It is therefore, according to the enchanted cartographers' guild, both precisely located and technically unconfirmed, which is a combination the Prophet has found reliable as a destination. The approach ridge is known. The bottom has not been reached by recorded expedition in some years.

The table now hosts the ordnance chart, a folded trail guide retrieved from Steve's jacket, and a length of recovery rope whose presence has not been explained and has not needed to be. The Jeep, informed of the destination by methods that remain unclear, has resumed humming. Departure window: not this weekend. Preparations are described as orderly, which is Christine's word. Steve's word was different.

stories.headline: Monday Reaches the Bank; Christine Has Briefed It; Two New Account-Holders Oriented Before the Lobby Fireplace Has Finished Warming
body: The first Monday following a successful expedition is, in the Liaison Wing, a known quantity: Christine arrives having already read the weekend correspondence, cross-referenced it against the outgoing ledger, and identified any discrepancies with the brisk efficiency of someone who also researched an access road on Sunday afternoon and found time to make dinner.

Two new account-holders, both of whom had been warned by their solicitors to expect a 'somewhat procedural' onboarding, were instead met at the lobby fireplace by Christine, oriented, and depositing within forty minutes. One of them later described the experience as 'nearly pleasant.' The other asked if she was available for a second appointment. The Duty Goblin has noted both outcomes in the log. He used Christine's format.

stories.headline: Ministry Issues Monday Bulletin Confirming Monday; Acknowledges the Hollow; Requests Clarification on Whether 'Harlan's Hollow' Is a Ministry-Registered Designation; Answer Is No; Ministry Notes This
body: The Monday bulletin, issued at nine-fifteen and running to four paragraphs, confirmed that Monday had begun, noted the return of regular working hours following what it described as 'a weekend of observed parameters,' and raised, in its third paragraph, an inquiry as to the registration status of Harlan's Hollow.

Cartographic records indicate no current registration. The hollow exists. The Ministry has placed it on a list of locations 'under consideration for future consideration.' The list, which has been under consideration for seven years, was not attached. The bulletin's fourth paragraph confirmed that Tuesday will follow. No objections were recorded.

stories.headline: Recovery Rope Draws Household Attention; Positions Staked; the Table's Population Grows
body: The arrival of the recovery rope on the kitchen table this morning prompted a brief but comprehensive household review. All three familiars were observed in the vicinity of the table between seven-oh-eight and seven-twenty. No rope was interfered with. This is confirmed. What happened between seven-oh-four and seven-oh-eight is not confirmed.

Jersey occupied the armchair nearest the table for the remainder of the morning, which sources characterise as moral support. Ellie examined the trail guide, briefly, with the expression of someone reading a menu in an unfamiliar language. Lucy has not been near the table since seven-twenty. The rope's condition is unchanged. These facts are noted without further comment.

familiars_corner: Lucy: was not near the recovery rope at any point this morning and would like that established clearly and early in the record; she was, at all relevant times, in the sitting room; the sitting room is not the kitchen; she cannot be expected to account for every room she was not in.

Ellie: studied the trail guide with great seriousness for approximately forty seconds, determined that it did not contain anything to eat, and has since been sitting in a patch of sunlight thinking, by all appearances, of nothing in particular, which she is very good at.

Jersey: has positioned himself on the armchair in a supervisory capacity and considers his presence near the table an important contribution to the expedition's logistical phase; he will also be available for lap-based support during the planning stages, the packing stages, and all stages not requiring him to leave the armchair.
founding_editor_note: Recovery rope on a kitchen table means someone's going somewhere worth going — I'd have built a proper bracket for it, but I'll allow the table. — D.

in_brief.sport: Monday morning weights logged before the Liaison Wing's first appointment; the account-holders did not know this and were treated exactly the same regardless.
in_brief.forecast: Fog in the hollow through midweek · the trail guide has been read once · the rope remains coiled and patient.

storyline_updates.title: The Second Circle
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: The three-word margin note has been identified as a trail name — Harlan's Hollow, four miles north-northeast, named on older charts and absent from newer ones. The table now holds the ordnance chart, a trail guide from Steve's jacket, and a recovery rope of unexplained but unquestioned presence. Christine has the access road; Steve has opinions recorded in his own word, which differs from 'orderly.' The Jeep is humming. The Ministry has placed the hollow on a list under consideration for future consideration. Departure window: not this weekend, but narrowing. Day 3 should bring one more preparation item — a mechanical thing Steve produces from the garage, or something Christine adds to the access-road notes — and possibly the first outside voice: someone who has been to the hollow, or claims to have, and has something to say about it.
